summary: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. filed a 6-K on May 27, 2026, disclosing a prospectus supplement to increase the maximum aggregate offering amount of American Depositary Shares (each representing 10,000 ordinary shares) under its existing At The Market Offering Agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co., LLC dated February 3, 2025. The filing updates the registration of up to $1,587,708 in additional ATM sales. It includes legal opinions and consents from counsel. This is a routine shelf takedown filing, not a special situation event, as it describes ongoing capital raising without a transformative corporate action.
